descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are looking for a skilled Java Fullstack Developer (React&Angular) to join our team and contribute to the development of innovative software solutions. In this role, you will be involved in building, testing, and deploying scalable web applications while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
 Responsibilities: 
Develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions for both front-end and back-end components of web applications using Java and related technologies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements, design solutions, and implement features aligned with business needs
Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices
Troubleshoot and debug issues and implement fixes to ensure application stability, performance, and security
Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies while continuously improving technical skills and knowledge
Manage and maintain application APIs and GUI infrastructure, including: VM creation and sizing, patching and security, upgrades and decommissioning activities.
 Requirements: 
 Must Have: 
4+ years of experience in Java development, with a focus on full stack web applications
Strong experience with Java and related technologies
Proficiency in front-end technologies and modern frameworks such as React and/or Angular
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns
Experience with Spring Boot, Hibernate, and RESTful APIs
Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, or HBase
Knowledge of RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Linux environments
Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines
Good level of English
Strong collaboration and communication skills
Openness to team support and knowledge sharing
Good understanding of the broader business and technical landscape
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 Nice to Have: 
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
French language skills or willingness to learn French
 Work Model: 
Hybrid work model – office presence required 2 days/week
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
